question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state recorded the highest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** has the** highest **sex ratio in India, according to the **2011 census**, with **1084 girls for every 1000 males.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu** ranks** second** with **996 girls for every 1000 males.**
 
• With a sex ratio of **993,** **Andhra Pradesh** ranks** third**, followed by** Chhattisgarh (991) **and **Meghalaya (989).**
 
• With** 879 girls for every 1000 males**, **Haryana** has the **poorest sex ratio** among the states.
 
• The** greatest sex ratio** among Union Territories is **1037 in Puducherry, **while the **lowest sex ratio is 618** in **Daman and Diu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sex ratio** is defined as the** proportion of females to males per thousand.**
 
• It is a crucial** sociological indicato**r for determining the degree of gender equality that exists in a nation at any particular period.
 
• The sex ratio of the population affects, and is affected by**, birth, death, immigration, and emigration rates.**
